channel.title: Microsoft 365 Message Center Archive
channel.description: Latest Microsoft 365 Message Center messages. Message Center posts vary by tenant; always use your tenant's Message Center as the source of truth.

item.title: MC1505610: Public CDN is becoming optional during Brand Center setup
item.description: Brand Center setup will no longer require enabling Public CDN by default, allowing organizations to use branding governance without it. Public CDN remains necessary for font features and must be explicitly enabled. This change rolls out worldwide in October 2026 with no action required unless fonts are used.

item.title: MC1505609: Microsoft 365 Copilot and Power Apps: Retirement of App Builder agent and vibe.powerapps.com
item.description: Microsoft is retiring the App Builder agent and vibe.powerapps.com by November 30, 2026, consolidating app creation into Copilot Cowork and Microsoft Copilot Studio. New app creation in retired platforms ends mid-October 2026. Organizations must migrate existing apps before retirement using upcoming in-product migration tools.

item.title: MC1505607: Outlook: Reply With a Template in Rules
item.description: New Outlook for Windows and Outlook on the web will let users create inbox rules that auto-reply with saved templates, automating routine responses. Rollout starts mid-October 2026 (Targeted Release) and completes by December 2026 (General Availability). No admin action is required before rollout.

item.title: MC1505599: Microsoft Purview Audit: AuditLogQuery API generally available and Search-UnifiedAuditLog retiring
item.description: The Microsoft Graph AuditLogQuery API will be generally available in October 2026, replacing the Search-UnifiedAuditLog PowerShell cmdlet, which will retire on October 15, 2027. Organizations using Search-UnifiedAuditLog must migrate to the API to avoid disruptions, as future audit search enhancements will focus on the API.

item.title: MC1429018: Microsoft Teams: Meeting memory file generation
item.description: Microsoft Teams will generate AI meeting memory files capturing key meeting insights to enhance Microsoft 365 Copilot and Facilitator responses. These files, stored securely in tenant-owned SharePoint, are enabled by default with admin controls and configurable retention. Rollout starts November 2026, requiring no immediate action but admin review.

item.title: MC1472601: Microsoft Purview: Archive SharePoint files under retention policies
item.description: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management will enable admins to archive inactive SharePoint files under retention policies starting December 2026. Archived files move to Microsoft 365 Archive, remain compliant and discoverable, and are excluded from Copilot indexing, improving response relevance. This feature requires admin configuration.

item.title: MC1325441: Microsoft Purview | Data Lifecycle Management - Archive SharePoint files under retention
item.description: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management will enable archiving SharePoint files based on retention policies to reduce storage costs while maintaining compliance. Archived files stay discoverable but are excluded from Copilot indexing. The feature requires admin configuration, with rollout from September to December 2026.

item.title: MC1483519: Dynamics 365 and Power Platform– Information about storage validation for Dataverse-only tenants
item.description: Beginning November 9, 2026, we are introducing staged storage validation for supported Dynamics 365 applications. The change gives administrators clearer visibility into storage use, advance notice of potential restrictions, and several ways to remain within capacity, including removing unneeded data, adding capacity, or enabling pay-as-you-go for sandbox environments. If no corrective action is initiated after repeated notifications, when a tenant exceeds its entitled Database, File, or Log cap...

item.title: MC1502773: Dynamics 365 Sales - Information regarding the retirement of the Dynamics 365 Sales Insights standalone add-on
item.description: Starting November 1, 2026, Dynamics 365 Sales Insights as a standalone add-on will have reached end of support. Sales Insights is a legacy offering whose capabilities are already included in Sales Premium. Sales Premium delivers the Sales Insights capabilities at the same price as the Sales Enterprise + Sales Insights combination. It also includes Copilot Credits, additional Dataverse storage capacity, and access to new Sales Premium capabilities. This change is intended to reduce licensing comp...

item.title: MC1387526: Microsoft 365 Backup: Full workload backup for SharePoint, OneDrive, and Exchange
item.description: Microsoft 365 Backup introduces Full Workload Backup for SharePoint, OneDrive, and Exchange, enabling admins to protect entire workloads with one policy. It automatically covers all existing and new artifacts, reduces admin effort, and supports enterprise data protection. Rollout begins July 2026; admin configuration is required to enable.

item.title: MC1253753: Whiteboards created in Teams channels will now be stored in SharePoint
item.description: Microsoft planned to store Teams channel Whiteboards in SharePoint for better access and compliance but decided not to proceed with this change. No action is required from admins, and existing storage in users' OneDrive remains. Compliance and access policies continue as before.

item.title: MC1392571: Connect Teams meeting to existing Planner Plans
item.description: Microsoft Teams meetings can now be linked to existing Microsoft Planner plans, allowing tasks to be tracked in one place instead of multiple plans. This feature, rolling out late December 2026 to January 2027, is enabled by default and supports automated or manual task creation via Facilitator.

item.title: MC796790: Unified management of app and agent availability and installation in Teams, Outlook, and the Microsoft 365 app
item.description: Microsoft is unifying app and agent availability and installation management across Teams, Outlook, and Microsoft 365 admin centers. Availability unification began in September 2025 in phases, with automatic unification planned. Installation unification starts late September 2026, synchronizing settings without admin action for eligible tenants.

item.title: MC1493186: Microsoft Outlook for Android and iOS: Send Availability functionality restored
item.description: The Send Availability feature is restored in Microsoft Outlook for Android and iOS, allowing users to share their meeting availability easily while composing emails. iOS users can also access it via the keyboard and VoiceOver. The update is available worldwide with no action required.

item.title: MC1492959: Audio Overview Updates
item.description: Microsoft is enhancing Audio Overview with topic-based episodes for easier navigation, support for sensitivity labels when saving to OneDrive, and expanded content types including OneNote, Loop pages, emails, and Teams chats. The update rolls out worldwide from late October to November 2026 with no admin action needed.

item.title: MC1492958: Microsoft Graph: New tenant controls for retirement of non-standard file API tokens
item.description: Microsoft will retire pre-authenticated (tempauth) URLs in SharePoint Online and OneDrive by April 1, 2027. New tenant controls will allow admins to test updated Microsoft Graph URL behavior using Microsoft Entra ID authentication. Apps must stop relying on embedded auth URLs and HTTP 302 redirects. Validation before the deadline is recommended.

item.title: MC1492955: Microsoft Planner: Introducing Local Custom Fields
item.description: Microsoft Planner introduces Local Custom Fields, allowing users with Planner Premium licenses to add up to 10 customizable fields (Text, Number, Date, Yes/No, Choice) to tasks for tailored workflows. Microsoft 365 users have read-only access. The rollout begins late October 2026, with no admin setup required. Custom fields integrate with existing compliance and audit features.

item.title: MC1492954: Microsoft Outlook: Themes by Copilot retirement
item.description: Themes by Copilot in Microsoft Outlook will be retired worldwide from mid- to late October 2026. Users with a Copilot license will lose the ability to select or revert to these themes, though current themes remain until changed. No action is required.

item.title: MC1462473: Microsoft Teams: PowerPoint Live introduces light mode for presenters
item.description: PowerPoint Live in Microsoft Teams will add a light mode option for presenters, alongside dark, classic, and high contrast modes. This update, rolling out from September to November 2026, enhances flexibility and accessibility without affecting presentation content or attendee views. No admin action is needed.

item.title: MC1492825: 30-Day Reminder: Windows 11, version 23H2 Enterprise and Education editions reach end of updates on November 10, 2026
item.description: On November 10, 2026, Windows 11, version 23H2 Enterprise and Education editions will reach end of updates. The November 2026 Windows security update will be the last update available for these editions. After this date, devices running these editions will no longer receive monthly security updates containing protections from the latest security threats. We recommend updating eligible devices running Windows 11, version 23H2 to a supported version of Windows 11. If you have an eligible device, y...

item.title: MC1484009: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: New email submissions data in Advanced Hunting
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 is adding two new Advanced Hunting tables, SubmissionEvents and SubmissionResults, to enhance email submission visibility and detection workflows. Public Preview starts early October 2026; General Availability begins late October 2026. No immediate action or compliance concerns are required.

item.title: MC1437671: Microsoft Entra: Authenticated password change in My Sign-Ins
item.description: Microsoft Entra will enable users to change passwords after secure sign-in using strong credentials (passkey, FIDO2, Windows Hello) without knowing the current password or using SSPR. This feature, disabled by default, requires admin activation and will roll out globally from October to November 2026.

item.title: MC1486284: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention: Administrative Units support for DLP policies for Microsoft Copilot
item.description: Microsoft has decided not to proceed with extending Microsoft Entra Administrative Units support to Microsoft Purview DLP policies for Microsoft Copilot. No changes will occur, and no action is required. Existing DLP policies and enforcement remain unchanged.

item.title: MC1492276: Dynamics 365 Contact Center - Improved feature discoverability within Contact Center Admin Center
item.description: We are announcing improvements for discovering the latest features and news about capabilities in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature will reach public preview on October 23, 2026. How does this affect me? With these discoverability improvements, administrators can more easily discover what's new, understand the value of key capabilities, and take the next step toward adoption. This feature connects administrators to relevant learning and adoption resources with two new experiences: A What...

item.title: MC1492166: Microsoft Outlook: New event duplication capability
item.description: Microsoft Outlook is adding a "Duplicate event" feature allowing users to quickly create new events from existing ones without re-entering details. The rollout began in late September 2026 and will complete by late October 2026. No action or compliance concerns are required.

item.title: MC1492165: Microsoft PowerPoint for Windows: Improved slide contextual menu consistency
item.description: Microsoft PowerPoint for Windows will update the slide contextual menu for better consistency and organization, removing the low-usage Photo Album command from the menu but keeping it in the Insert tab. The rollout starts in October 2026, requires no action, and affects all users.

item.title: MC1492164: Microsoft PowerPoint for Mac: Improved slide contextual menu consistency
item.description: Microsoft PowerPoint for Mac will update slide contextual menus for consistency, removing the Zoom command and Cut/Copy from the slide menu but keeping them elsewhere. Layout and Reset Slide commands will appear in both slide and thumbnail menus. The change rolls out worldwide in October 2026, enabled by default with no impact on compliance or licensing.

item.title: MC1492163: Microsoft API Hub: Zendesk OAuth tokens will require expiration and automatic refresh
item.description: Microsoft API Hub will update Zendesk OAuth tokens to expire after 48 hours with refresh tokens expiring after 90 days, supporting automatic refresh. Existing connections must be reauthorized by early 2027 to avoid failures. Organizations should identify and reauthorize affected connections and inform developers.

item.title: MC1492161: Microsoft 365 Copilot in PowerPoint: 'Clarify my thinking' skill for desktop
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot in PowerPoint on desktop introduces the "Clarify my thinking" skill, helping users refine ideas and improve presentations. Rolling out worldwide from October 8, 2026, it requires no admin action but may need user communication and training updates. Existing Copilot controls and licensing apply.

item.title: MC1492160: Microsoft 365 Copilot in PowerPoint: 'Clarify my thinking' skill for web
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot in PowerPoint on web introduces the "Clarify my thinking" skill, helping users refine ideas and improve presentations. Rolling out worldwide from October 8, 2026, it requires no admin action but may need user communication and training updates. Existing Copilot controls and licensing apply.

item.title: MC1492159: Microsoft 365 Copilot in PowerPoint: 'Clarify my thinking' skill for Mac
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot in PowerPoint on Mac introduces the "Clarify my thinking" skill to help users refine ideas and improve presentations. Rolling out worldwide from October 8, 2026, it requires no admin action but may need user communication and training updates. Existing controls and licensing apply.

item.title: MC1492156: Microsoft PowerPoint for Windows: Smarter Keep Source Formatting slide pasting experience
item.description: PowerPoint for Windows now imports only necessary slide masters and layouts when pasting slides with Keep Source Formatting, reducing file size and improving performance. Users can revert to the old behavior via a setting. Rollout began September 2026, completing by October 2026. No action required.

item.title: MC1492155: Microsoft PowerPoint for Mac: Smarter Keep Source Formatting slide pasting experience
item.description: PowerPoint for Mac now imports only necessary slide masters and layouts when pasting slides with Keep Source Formatting, reducing file size and improving performance and collaboration. Users can revert to the old behavior via settings. Rollout began late September 2026, completing by late October 2026. No action required.

item.title: MC1491832: Take action to prevent RD Web Access rendering failures
item.description: The Remote Desktop Web Access (RD Web Access) experience included with Windows Server relies on Extensible Stylesheet Language Transformations (XSLT) to render its web interface. Chromium-based and other browsers are disabling XSLT support in the short term. As browsers disable this feature, the RD Web Access experience included with Windows Server will no longer render as expected. Microsoft has published KB5130994 with workarounds for organizations that continue to use this experience. Rollout...

item.title: MC1462915: Allow connections to copilot.cloud.microsoft before the Copilot URL redirect
item.description: Starting September 2026, Microsoft will redirect users from m365.cloud.microsoft to copilot.cloud.microsoft. Organizations must allow connections to *.cloud.microsoft in network and security controls to avoid Copilot access disruptions. Validate connectivity, update allow lists, and coordinate with security teams before the redirect.

item.title: MC1491763: Prepare for Windows Update certificate rotation in 2027
item.description: What and whyCertificates that help devices establish trusted connections to Windows Update will expire on May 17, 2027, and June 19, 2027. Devices must contain the replacement certificates to continue connecting to Windows Update and receiving updates after the applicable expiration date. Microsoft has delivered the replacement certificates through Windows security updates. Most devices running an in-support version of Windows require no additional action if they are current with monthly Windows...

item.title: MC1491762: Windows Office Hours: October 15, 2026
item.description: If you are an IT admin with questions about managing and updating Windows, we want to help. Every third Thursday of the month, we host a live chat-based event on the Tech Community called Windows Office Hours. Members of the Windows, Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, Windows Autopatch, and Windows 365 engineering teams will be standing by to answer your questions. Want to attend the October 15 session of Office Hours? Add it to your calendar and select Attend on the event page to let us know...

item.title: MC1459133: Microsoft Entra ID: Passkey support for B2B users
item.description: Microsoft Entra ID will support passkey registration and sign-in for B2B users, enabling phishing-resistant MFA in resource tenants starting late October 2026. Internal guest users get Microsoft Authenticator app passkeys; external users do not. The feature is enabled by default, intersecting with SMS/voice retirement policies. No action required, but administrators should review policies.

item.title: MC1450133: Microsoft Entra: Users can register a passkey or passwordless sign-in as their first multifactor authentication method
item.description: Microsoft Entra will allow users to register passkeys or passwordless sign-in as their first multifactor authentication method, removing the need to set up SMS or voice first. This phased rollout begins late October 2026, aiming to ease adoption of phishing-resistant authentication without requiring user action.

item.title: MC1465780: Outlook for iOS and Android: Automatically apply email sensitivity labels from labeled attachments
item.description: Outlook for iOS and Android will automatically apply or recommend email sensitivity labels based on attached files with Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels starting mid-November 2026. This enhances consistent data protection, reduces manual labeling, and supports compliance without requiring admin action. Organizations should review label policies accordingly.

item.title: MC1461152: Create interactive slides in PowerPoint with Copilot skill (Windows and Mac)
item.description: PowerPoint's new Copilot skill "Create interactive slide" enables users on Windows, Mac, and web to easily create interactive, full-slide visuals for complex concepts, timelines, and data. Attendees can interact independently in PowerPoint Live for Teams. Rollout begins mid-October 2026; a Copilot license is required.

item.title: MC1490912: Microsoft Teams: Call quality feedback surveys for Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce call quality feedback surveys for Teams Rooms on Android starting November 2026. Users can rate audio, video, and screen-sharing quality after meetings. Feedback helps improve Teams services. No admin action is required before rollout; updating the app and informing users is recommended.

item.title: MC1490911: Microsoft Edge: Retiring legacy sign-in implementation on Windows
item.description: Microsoft Edge on Windows will retire its legacy direct-WAM sign-in in version 157, fully adopting the OneAuth library to standardize authentication. Rollout starts and completes in November 2026. Admins should identify unmigrated profiles, test transitions, and prepare for possible user sign-in prompts.

item.title: MC1490909: Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management: Private preview for selected developer package vulnerability coverage
item.description: Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management is privately previewing expanded vulnerability coverage for selected Node.js, Python, and Java packages on Windows devices. It integrates with existing workflows, APIs, and exports, with rollout planned from September to December 2026. Organizations should prepare for increased data volume and validate integrations before enabling.

item.title: MC1490906: Microsoft Teams: Analytics for desk utilization in Teams Pro Management portal
item.description: Microsoft Teams Pro Management portal will add desk utilization analytics, showing usage, reservations, occupancy, and peak patterns. Requires desks with peripheral devices and appropriate Shared Space licenses. Rolling out worldwide from November to mid-December 2026 to aid space planning without compliance concerns.

item.title: MC1490905: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Post-delivery protection for malicious QR codes in Microsoft Teams
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 extends Teams URL protection to detect malicious URLs in QR codes post-delivery, warning users and enabling security teams to investigate via Advanced Hunting. Rolling out worldwide from October to November 2026, no user action is required, but admins should review related settings and processes.

item.title: MC1490903: 'Record A Skill' Capability in PowerPoint Copilot
item.description: PowerPoint Copilot will introduce a "Record a Skill" feature in October 2026, allowing users to record and reuse workflows for common tasks. This enhances efficiency and consistency without requiring admin action. Organizations should inform support teams and users about this new capability.

item.title: MC1490899: Microsoft 365: Targeted Release retirement
item.description: Microsoft 365 Targeted Release will retire in January 2027, replaced by Frontier, Standard, and Deferred release options. Administrators must update user enrollments and release preferences by November 2026, when Targeted Release management ends and a unified release preferences experience launches in the admin center.

item.title: MC1454378: Microsoft 365: The Next Generation of File & Folder Sharing
item.description: Microsoft 365 introduces a third-generation sharing experience with a single "hero link" for files and folders, simplifying access control and updates. Rolling out worldwide from October to November 2026, it affects SharePoint, OneDrive, and Microsoft 365 sharing, with no required user action before rollout.

item.title: MC1490598: Interim guidance for Manitoba time zone changes
item.description: What and why:A time zone change affects Windows devices in Manitoba, with Windows releasing a fix in October 2026. Manitoba is permanently moving to UTC-5 and will not set its clocks back on November 1, 2026. Microsoft recommends a temporary workaround for devices that can't be updated in time. For the workaround steps and full guidance, visit the Daylight Saving Time & Time Zone Blog. Rollout schedule:October 2026 – The Manitoba time zone will be included with the October 2026 Windows security...

item.title: MC1388706: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Legal agent available in Frontier worldwide
item.description: Copilot for Legal is now in Public Preview worldwide for Frontier users, expanding beyond the U.S. It helps legal professionals review contracts, identify risks, compare clauses, and generate tracked changes. No separate installation is needed; access requires Frontier enrollment and Copilot licenses.

item.title: MC1227622: Transitioning Teams Android Device Management from Teams admin Center to the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal
item.description: Teams Android device management is transitioning from the Teams admin center to the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal by July 2026, consolidating management of all Teams devices into one portal. Deprecation of device management in TAC will begin October 2026, with phased rollouts and migration guidance provided.

item.title: MC1479509: Spell check before sending emails in new Outlook
item.description: Starting mid-October to mid-December 2026, new Outlook for Windows and Outlook on the web will roll out an automatic spell check before sending emails. Users can enable this feature if Connected Experiences are on. Organizations should review privacy policies and update training accordingly.

item.title: MC1489971: Microsoft Purview DLP: Improved setup and Intune multi-admin approval support for unmanaged apps in Edge for Business
item.description: Starting November 2026, Microsoft Purview DLP will improve setup and support Intune multi-admin approval for unmanaged apps in Edge for Business, offering clearer status, detailed errors, and task coordination between Purview and Intune admins without changing existing policies or enforcement.

item.title: MC1479516: Microsoft Outlook: Link preview retirement
item.description: The Link Preview feature in new Outlook for Windows and Outlook on the web has been retired due to the deprecation of the browser service needed for previews. Links remain clickable, no action is required, but users should be informed that preview cards will no longer appear.

item.title: MC1489942: Microsoft Viva Insights: New Power BI report publishing capabilities for leaders
item.description: Microsoft Viva Insights is expanding Power BI report publishing to leaders, allowing them to publish and distribute reports directly. The "Analyst report publish" setting is renamed "Report publish," managed by admins and on by default. Rollout begins November 2026, with no action required but governance review recommended.

item.title: MC1489931: Microsoft 365 Backup: Activity Logs
item.description: Microsoft 365 Backup will introduce activity logs by mid-October 2026, enabling administrators to monitor backup and restore activities across SharePoint Online, OneDrive, and Exchange Online. Logs include detailed metadata, filtering, search, export options, and role-based access within the Microsoft 365 admin center. No action required.

item.title: MC1489928: Microsoft Brand Kit: Duplicate an existing Brand Kit
item.description: Microsoft now allows Brand Managers and Brand Kit owners to duplicate existing Brand Kits to create new ones, simplifying setup for different brands or regions. This feature is available worldwide with no action required, aiming to reduce manual effort and improve efficiency in Brand Kit management.

item.title: MC1489926: Microsoft Create: Improved sharing controls for Brand Kits
item.description: Microsoft Create now allows Brand Kit owners to modify sharing permissions after sharing, including changing user access between view and edit or removing access. This feature is available worldwide with no action required, helping organizations better manage Brand Kit access as collaboration needs evolve.

item.title: MC1477185: Microsoft OneDrive: New pay-as-you-go storage billing option
item.description: Microsoft is introducing a pay-as-you-go billing option for additional OneDrive storage, allowing admins to let selected accounts exceed licensed quotas with automatic usage-based billing. Public preview is available now for commercial tenants, with general availability starting November 2026. No action is needed if unused.

item.description: We've released updates to the following update channel for Microsoft 365 Apps: Current Channel When this will happen: We'll be gradually rolling out this update of Microsoft 365 Apps to users on that update channel starting October 6th, 2026 (PST). How this will affect your organization: If your Microsoft 365 Apps clients are configured to automatically update from the Office Content Delivery Network (CDN), then no action is required. If you manage updates directly you can now download this late...

item.title: MC1480873: Connected Platforms - Agent 365 extends observability to third-party agents
item.description: Microsoft Agent 365 will support observability for third-party agents from Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, and Anthropic Claude, enabling unified monitoring of runs, sessions, and exceptions. Rollout begins late October 2026 with admin controls for enabling data collection and platform-specific setup requirements.

item.title: MC1479514: Microsoft Teams: Improved file sharing experience in external chats
item.description: Microsoft Teams will enable Attach file and drag-and-drop for external chats by default starting late October 2026, improving file sharing. Files are stored in the sender’s OneDrive with automatic permission assignment, subject to existing OneDrive/SharePoint policies. Admins can disable this via Teams PowerShell settings.

item.title: MC1489590: Dynamics 365 Project Operations - Assign task level calendar for precise planning
item.description: We are announcing the ability to assign task level calendar for precise planning in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. This feature will reach general availability on September 30, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature provides an experience to change the task calendar on the Customizable task details pane. To enable this feature, from project parameters select Enable Customize Task Pane. When enabled through feature control, this functionality lets you:Set a task-level calendar on the Custo...

item.title: MC1472022: [Outlook Mac] Purview Data Loss Prevention support for Calendar Events
item.description: Outlook for Mac will support Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention for calendar events starting mid-November 2026, helping organizations prevent sensitive data sharing in meeting details. Existing DLP policies will automatically apply, requiring no admin action, enhancing consistent compliance across email and calendar.

item.title: MC1472023: [Outlook Mobile] Purview Data Loss Prevention support for Calendar Events
item.description: Outlook for iOS and Android will support Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention for calendar events starting mid-November 2026, helping prevent sensitive data sharing in meeting details. No admin action is needed; existing DLP policies will automatically apply, enhancing compliance across email and calendar.

item.title: MC1472019: [Outlook Mac] Purview DLP Wait-on-Send Support
item.description: Outlook for Mac will support Microsoft Purview DLP wait-on-send policies starting mid-November 2026, allowing organizations to enforce DLP evaluations before sending emails. This enhances data protection by controlling wait times for policy checks, improving compliance and user experience. Administrators should review and configure policies accordingly.

item.title: MC1472021: [Outlook Mobile] Purview DLP Wait-on-Send Support
item.description: Outlook for iOS and Android will support Microsoft Purview DLP wait-on-send policies starting mid-November 2026, allowing organizations to enforce DLP evaluations before sending emails. Administrators can configure wait times to enhance policy compliance and balance security with user productivity. Review and enable as needed.

item.title: MC1465779: Outlook for Mac: Sensitivity label recommendations and auto-labeling from attachments
item.description: Outlook for Mac will auto-apply or recommend Microsoft Purview sensitivity labels for emails based on attached files' labels, enhancing consistent information protection. Rollout begins mid-November 2026. No admin action is required, but organizations should review label policies and inform relevant teams.

item.title: MC1454113: Microsoft Copilot Word: Document summarization experience moving
item.description: Starting September 2026, Microsoft Word's document summarization will move from the Top of Doc experience to other Copilot surfaces, maintaining AI-powered summaries accessible via Copilot prompts. No admin action is needed, but user communication and training updates are recommended.

item.title: MC1446805: Microsoft Viva: Targeted audience surveys in the Copilot dashboard
item.description: Microsoft Viva introduces targeted audience surveys in the Copilot dashboard, allowing authorized users (CxO or delegates) to send Viva Pulse surveys to predefined Copilot user groups dynamically filtered from dashboard data. The feature rolls out from mid-August to mid-November 2026, enabled by default for eligible organizations.

item.title: MC1484013: Microsoft Teams: Multi-line call history tabs in the Calls app
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce multi-line call history tabs in the Calls app for users with multi-line calling, organizing call activity by phone line. The rollout begins early November 2026, with no action required. This update affects desktop and web Teams and simplifies managing multiple phone lines.

item.title: MC1470410: Microsoft Teams: QR code protection for messages from external users
item.description: Microsoft Teams will blur QR code images from external users by default starting mid-October 2026 to reduce phishing risks. Users can reveal images if trusted. No admin action is needed, but admins should inform users and update related guidance. The feature applies across all Teams platforms automatically.

item.title: MC1462921: Calls popout into a new window on the browser to support multi-tasking and collaboration during a meeting
item.description: Microsoft Teams for Web will introduce a Picture-in-Picture Call Monitor starting mid-October 2026, allowing users to manage meetings in a separate window while multitasking in other browser tabs. No admin action is needed, but users should have supported browsers and support staff should be informed.

item.title: MC1485411: Microsoft Excel: Excel canvas
item.description: Excel canvas, a new Copilot feature in Microsoft Excel, creates dynamic reports with visualizations and insights that update automatically with data changes. Available worldwide by late October 2026, it supports natural language interaction for report customization. No action is required; notify users and update training materials as needed.

item.title: MC1486295: Microsoft OneDrive and SharePoint: Generate smart tables of contents for PDFs on the web with Copilot
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot users can generate AI-created, hierarchical, clickable tables of contents for PDFs in OneDrive and SharePoint on the web starting December 2026. The feature is user-initiated, respects permissions, supports saving by editors, and may have inaccuracies, especially with scanned PDFs.

item.title: MC1422063: OneDrive for Business: Improved Windows Desktop sync error messages for max path length
item.description: OneDrive for Business on Windows will improve sync error messages for paths exceeding 520 characters, guiding users to rename or move items without stopping sync. This update, rolling out from late October to November 2026, aims to reduce confusion and support tickets with no admin action needed.

item.title: MC1338816: New Outlook for Windows becomes available for GCC High and DoD
item.description: New Outlook for Windows will be available in GCC High and DoD environments starting Public Preview July 30, 2026, has rolled out. It remains off by default and opt-in, allowing admins control via policies and registry keys. Migration from COM to web add-ins is recommended.

item.title: MC1488847: Microsoft Teams: Breakout room support for Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms on Android will support breakout rooms, allowing meeting organizers to assign and move these devices between breakout and main rooms. This feature, improving coordination and feature parity with Windows, will roll out worldwide from mid to late November 2026. No action is required.

item.title: MC1488845: Private tasks now stored in your private plan in Planner
item.description: Starting November 2026, private tasks in Microsoft Planner will be stored in users' private Planner plans instead of Microsoft To Do, enabling richer features while remaining private. Existing tasks stay visible in Planner. No admin action is needed, but organizations should update documentation and compliance processes accordingly.

item.title: MC1488844: Updated My Task experience in Planner
item.description: Microsoft Planner's My Tasks experience will be redesigned for clearer navigation, better task organization, and streamlined task creation, enhancing productivity. The update rolls out worldwide from early to late November 2026, requires no user action, and preserves existing tasks and settings.

item.title: MC1488843: Microsoft Word for Android: Agent Mode
item.description: Microsoft Word for Android will gain Copilot Agent Mode by late September 2026, enabling users to draft, reason, and refine content with AI assistance. No admin action is needed, but organizations should update guidance and review policies to align with this new task-oriented Copilot experience.

item.title: MC1488841: Microsoft Outlook: Update to default blocked file types in OwaMailboxPolicy
item.description: Outlook on the web and new Outlook for Windows will block .msix and .msixbundle file types by default in OwaMailboxPolicy starting November 2026 to enhance security. Organizations using these file types should whitelist them beforehand; no action is needed if not used.

item.title: MC1488834: Microsoft Entra ID: Final reminder to replace MemberOf rule operator configurations by November 3, 2026
item.description: Microsoft Entra ID will retire the MemberOf rule operator by November 3, 2026. Organizations must replace MemberOf in dynamic groups, administrative units, and entitlement policies to avoid outdated memberships, access, and licensing issues. After this date, MemberOf-based updates will stop, impacting Conditional Access and related services.

item.title: MC1446797: Microsoft Teams: Modernized Gallery view in Teams Rooms on Android

item.description: Microsoft Teams Panels will add an admin setting to show or hide organizer names in Calendar View, configurable via the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal or panel device. item.description: Microsoft Edge's Copilot is updated with a new icon, simplified UX, and enhanced features like Voice and Vision. item.description: Upgrade the ExchangeOnlineManagement PowerShell module to version 3.10.1 or later by March 31, 2027, to avoid authentication failures due to new security enhancements. item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) will add a Copilot chat pane with a Summary feature in OneNote Mobile (Android) by end of October 2026, enabling users to generate summaries and ask questions about notes. Existing Copilot controls apply; no admin action is needed before rollout.

item.title: MC1470887: Microsoft Teams: Personal message reminders for chat and channels

item.description: Microsoft Outlook's Copilot experience will be updated in October 2026 to a simplified, chat-centered design with improved navigation, chat layout, and Work IQ controls. item.description: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management is retiring the Data Risk Graph by December 8, 2026. item.title: MC1481316: Microsoft Teams: Enable Teams apps and agents for existing applications in your organization
item.description: Microsoft Teams will enable admins to discover and recommend Teams apps and agents linked to third-party applications already used in their organization, improving integration and reducing app switching. item.description: Microsoft Purview introduces a new auto-labeling policy coverage report to help administrators track labeling progress, identify issues, and assess policy effectiveness. item.description: Microsoft SharePoint will introduce the Remove-SPOFontFile PowerShell cmdlet by mid-October 2026, allowing admins to delete brand fonts across geographies. item.description: Microsoft Teams will enhance Real-Time Alerting rule management in the Teams admin center by enabling rule duplication, bulk user uploads, and direct rule deletion. item.description: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery will support selecting user-owned SharePoint Embedded containers as data sources for cases, searches, and holds starting mid-September 2026. item.description: User.ReadBasic.All will no longer provide access to user app role assignments and license details starting mid-September 2026 to fix a security issue. item.description: Microsoft Purview DLP integrates with Entra Global Secure Access Internet Access to filter sensitive files at the network layer, preventing data leaks to unmanaged cloud apps. item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce a new admin policy to automatically block identified external meeting bots from joining meetings, enhancing security. item.description: Power BI is updating subscription notification delivery to improve reliability and sender reputation, changing sender identity, email formatting, and Copilot summary presentation. item.description: Microsoft Entra ID is optimizing passkey registration to better align with administrator policies, prioritize local device passkeys, and improve successful registrations without UI changes. The rollout begins late August 2026, completing by mid-September. No action is required; organizations should continue promoting passkey adoption.

item.description: Microsoft Teams is updating RTMP-In port and domain requirements to improve streaming reliability. Admins must allow outbound access to ports 50118, 50119, and domain *.rtmpingest.mcr.teams.cloud.microsoft by January 31, 2027. Existing RTMP-In events work until end of 2026; new events require updates to avoid failure.

item.title: MC1403410: Microsoft Viva: Agent flexible query in Analytics Workbench
item.description: Microsoft Viva Insights Analytics Workbench will add a flexible query feature in late September 2026, enabling analysts to explore Microsoft 365 Copilot agent usage with customizable queries. item.title: MC1466760: Microsoft Copilot Pages: Access existing Pages from the "/" menu in chat

item.title: MC1466757: Microsoft Teams: Collect information with List Form in Workflows

item.title: MC1326509: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection- File Labeler and File Viewer for MacOS
item.description: Microsoft Purview Information Protection is introducing File Labeler and File Viewer apps for macOS, enabling sensitivity labeling and protected file viewing like on Windows. Public preview starts May 29, 2026, with general availability on November 30, 2026. Advanced label-based protection is not supported initially.

item.title: MC1466307: Microsoft Teams: Centralized notification settings for channels
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce centralized channel notification settings, allowing users to manage all channel notifications from one location. item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce a "Report a concern" feature in meetings by late 2026, allowing users to report suspicious behavior like phishing or scams. Reports, including meeting metadata, will be accessible to administrators via Microsoft Defender and Teams admin center for investigation and response. This feature is enabled by default.

item.title: MC688109: Co-organizer experience updates in Teams Webinars and Townhalls
item.description: Co-organizers in Teams Webinars and Townhalls can now fully manage events, including editing details, publishing, and canceling, achieving parity with organizers. Rollout starts mid-January 2025 for targeted release and mid-June 2026 for general availability, with no preparation needed.

item.title: MC1307982: Microsoft Teams Town halls: Upload custom backgrounds in Manage what attendees see
item.description: Microsoft Teams will allow organizers and presenters of town hall events with Teams Premium licenses to upload custom background images in the "Manage what attendees see" feature. This rollout begins early June 2026, enhancing branded visuals behind presenters and shared content in supported layouts.

item.title: MC1250273: Improved copy and paste support for @mentions and shared contacts in Microsoft Teams
item.description: Microsoft Teams will improve copy-paste support for @mentions and shared contacts by preserving interactive tags when valid in the destination. If invalid, tags revert to plain text with original display. Rollout occurs May to mid-September 2026 across platforms, requiring no admin action and enhancing messaging consistency.

item.title: MC1197146: Express voice enrollment in Microsoft Teams
item.description: Express voice enrollment in Microsoft Teams enables quick voice profile registration for enhanced features like speaker recognition and improved transcripts. Rolling out mid-June to mid-September 2026 for commercial tenants (excluding EDU), it is ON by default but can be managed or disabled by admins via PowerShell settings.

item.title: MC1459131: Microsoft Teams: Prepare custom apps for private and shared channel compatibility
item.description: Microsoft Teams will roll out a feature by mid-September 2026 to help admins identify custom line-of-business apps needing updates for private and shared channel compatibility. Updating these apps ensures business continuity, reduces support issues, and maintains app access across evolving channel experiences.

item.title: MC1454108: Microsoft 365 Copilot app update: Simpler Copilot access
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot app is updating to a unified app for personal and work accounts with clearer visual cues, a simpler name and icon, and a new web URL (copilot.cloud.microsoft). Rollout begins mid-August 2026, with no changes to security, compliance, or enterprise controls.

item.title: MC1455013: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management- Azure PST Import
item.description: Azure PST Import enables Microsoft 365 admins to import PST files from Azure Blob Storage into Exchange Online mailboxes using PowerShell. The process includes readiness analysis, import execution, and compliance auditing. Rollout begins December 2026, requiring specific Azure permissions and mailbox prerequisites, with no direct user impact.

item.title: MC1281505: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management- Azure PST Import
item.description: Azure PST Import enables Microsoft 365 admins to import PST files from Azure Blob Storage into Exchange Online mailboxes via PowerShell. It includes readiness validation, reporting, and audit logging. Rollout starts mid-October 2026 (public preview) and early December 2026 (worldwide). No GUI; admin-driven process.

item.title: MC1422060: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Prompt injection protection for email
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 will introduce prompt injection protection for email, detecting and quarantining malicious content targeting AI assistants. Rolling out from July to October 2026, it affects organizations with Defender Plan 2 or Microsoft 365 E5, enabling automatic high-confidence threat quarantine by default with no required action.

item.title: MC1247902: SharePoint: AI citations analytics for documents and pages
item.description: SharePoint will add AI copilot citation analytics for documents, pages, and news posts, showing how often content is referenced by Microsoft 365 Copilot chat. Available to tenants with over 50 Copilot licenses, rollout starts end of August 2026. No admin action is needed; site owners get new usage insights.

item.title: MC1465777: Enhanced Slide Navigation with Up and Down Arrow Keys in PPT Live
item.description: PowerPoint Live now allows slide navigation using Up and Down Arrow keys, enhancing presenter control. This update, rolling out globally from mid-August to early September 2026, requires no action but may prompt updates to training materials. Existing navigation methods remain unchanged.

item.title: MC1465773: Microsoft Viva Engage: Microsoft Entra permissions required for community and membership administration
item.description: Starting late September 2026, Microsoft Viva Engage will require Microsoft Entra permissions—Yammer Administrator role or Community Admin assignment—for community and membership management tasks previously allowed to Verified or Network Admins. Administrators should review and update role assignments accordingly.

item.title: MC1465771: Microsoft Defender XDR: DLP alerts will be set as behaviors by default
item.description: Microsoft Defender XDR will set Microsoft Purview DLP alerts as behaviors by default starting October 12, 2026, reducing alert volume while keeping DLP data accessible in Advanced Hunting and Purview. Administrators can disable this rule to retain DLP alerts in the Defender XDR incident queue.

item.title: MC1465770: General Availability of Power BI developer mode
item.description: Power BI developer mode and the PBIP file format are generally available, making PBIR the default report format in Power BI Desktop and service. This enhances source control, CI/CD, and programmatic development. PBIX remains primary, with no impact on report functionality. No user action is required.

item.title: MC1465764: Teams web client users will be redirected to teams.cloud.microsoft
item.description: Teams web users will be redirected from teams.microsoft.com to teams.cloud.microsoft by September 2026. This domain change won't affect features or existing links. Temporary admin control to disable redirect ends December 31, 2026. Organizations should update documentation and ensure network access to *.cloud.microsoft.

item.title: MC1330893: Pay-as-you-go consumption-based meter for your extra SharePoint storage needs
item.description: Microsoft is introducing a pay-as-you-go billing model for SharePoint storage overages, allowing admins to pay only for extra storage used beyond the quota. Available from November 2026, it’s opt-in, excludes education tenants, and requires Azure billing permissions. No user impact; manual storage purchase remains an option.

item.title: MC1311978: Classic Outlook for Windows: User-initiated insights with Copilot
item.description: User-initiated insights with Copilot in classic Outlook for Windows allow users to highlight email text and prompt Copilot for contextual insights. Rolling out worldwide: Public Preview in May 2026, General Availability in October 2026. Feature is on by default for eligible users and integrates seamlessly without add-ins.

item.title: MC1413302: Discussion post previews coming to Viva Engage
item.description: Microsoft Viva Engage will introduce discussion post previews starting early September 2026, allowing users to review post formatting and presentation before publishing. This feature requires no admin setup, affects all Viva Engage users, and aims to improve communication quality. Organizations should inform users and update training accordingly.

item.title: MC1330891: Microsoft Teams: Breakout rooms now supported in meetings with up to 1,000 attendees
item.description: Microsoft Teams now supports breakout rooms in meetings with up to 1,000 attendees, allowing up to 100 breakout rooms per meeting. This feature, enabled by default, removes the previous 300-attendee limit and will roll out from July to September 2026. No action is required.

item.title: MC1443514: Microsoft Planner: Planner Agent chat in basic plans
item.description: Planner Agent chat is coming to Microsoft Planner basic plans starting September 2026, allowing users with Microsoft 365 Copilot licenses to interact with plans via AI-powered chat. It provides insights, task management, and plan creation using natural language and Microsoft 365 data, with admin controls for access.

item.title: MC1245222: Outlook: Share Word, Excel and PowerPoint local files via the new Outlook for Windows
item.description: The new Outlook for Windows will support sending locally stored Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files as email attachments starting early November 2026 (worldwide) and mid-January 2027 (GCC). This feature is on by default, requires no admin action, and aligns with classic Outlook functionality.

item.title: MC1069563: Microsoft 365 admin center: Usage reports to manage metered consumption costs for Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat (preview)
item.description: A new Message consumption usage report for Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat pay-as-you-go billing is now in preview, showing message usage by tenant, user, agent, and billing policy. It alerts when users exceed 2000 billed messages. General availability begins January 2027 with automatic rollout.

item.title: MC1423108: Microsoft Entra: Improved restore experience for Authenticator passkeys on iOS
item.description: Microsoft Entra improves the iOS Microsoft Authenticator app's passkey restore experience with a clearer, guided flow for device migration, launching worldwide mid-September 2026. It affects iOS users with iCloud backup, requires no action, and includes updated user guidance without policy changes.

item.title: MC1318124: Microsoft Teams: New search experience for cloud files in the file attach picker
item.description: Microsoft Teams will enable search for cloud files directly in the attach file picker starting June 2026, improving quick sharing by allowing users to find files faster without changing existing permissions. Rollout completes by September 2026, requiring no action but optional user communication and documentation updates.

item.title: MC1465692: More control for Windows Autopatch updates: quality updates, .NET Framework, and quick machine recovery
item.description: What and why: Windows Autopatch is expanding to provide a streamlined experience for managing Windows quality updates, supported .NET Framework updates, and quick machine recovery updates. item.title: MC1431365: Copilot Analytics - Agent 365 dashboard for managers
item.description: The Agent 365 Dashboard for managers will roll out worldwide and in GCC from mid to late September 2026, extending team-level Microsoft Copilot Analytics access. Managers can view consolidated agent adoption and usage insights. Organizations should review VFAM settings to manage access and update relevant documentation.

item.title: MC1450130: OneNote: Multimodal capture in Copilot Notebooks (Android)
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot Notebooks' multimodal capture—combining audio transcription, image capture, and typed notes—is expanding to OneNote for Android. Available from mid-August 2026 (preview) and mid-September (general), it generates AI-structured pages saved in Copilot Notebooks, requiring Microsoft 365 Copilot and SharePoint/OneDrive licenses.

item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot updates Memory to personalize responses using chat history, with refreshed user controls for managing Saved Memory. Public preview starts mid-November 2025; general availability begins mid-September 2026. Existing admin settings remain unchanged, and users can control personalization via updated settings.

item.title: MC1188222: Microsoft Teams: Private chat for organizers and presenters in structured meetings, webinars, and town halls
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce a private chat for organizers, co-organizers, and presenters in structured meetings, webinars, and town halls, unifying backroom chat behavior. Rollout occurs from mid-October to late November 2026. Admins should review policies, communicate changes, and update documentation accordingly.

item.description: We are announcing the ability to use time zone-agnostic fields in resource planning in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. item.description: We are announcing the ability to configure the presence sync between Dynamics Contact Center and Microsoft Teams. This feature will reach general availability on September 30, 2026. item.description: Microsoft will disable creation of classic publishing sites and pages in SharePoint Online starting March 1, 2027, and make existing classic user-created pages read-only by October 1, 2028. Custom scripting will be disabled. Organizations should assess usage and plan phased modernization to modern SharePoint experiences.

item.description: We are announcing platform observability and plug-in performance in Dynamics 365 Contact Center. This feature will reach public preview on September 14, 2026. item.description: We are announcing an update to currency accounting that ensures that currencies that differ from your base currency will include the correct label in Dynamics 365 Project Operations. item.title: MC1268933: Viva Engage: Pinned resources and related communities in Teams for iOS
item.description: Viva Engage in Microsoft Teams for iOS will add pinned resources and related communities from mid-June to September 2026, aligning with other platforms. Users and community admins will see these features by default with no admin changes needed. Communication and documentation updates are recommended.

item.title: MC1463510: External messaging limits for onmicrosoft.com-only organizations in Microsoft Teams
item.description: Microsoft Teams will impose outbound external messaging limits starting mid-September 2026 for organizations using only the default onmicrosoft.com domain to reduce spam and abuse. Limits may temporarily block external messages but won't affect internal communication. Admins should consider adding a custom domain and prepare support staff.

item.title: MC1463509: Organization skills support in Copilot for PowerPoint (Frontier release)
item.description: Microsoft will roll out organizational skills support for Copilot in PowerPoint (web, Windows, Mac) by early September 2026. Tenant admins can add and manage reusable, organization-specific skills via the Microsoft 365 admin center, enhancing user guidance without requiring pre-rollout action.

item.title: MC1230889: Outlook for Windows report retirement in the Exchange admin center
item.description: The Outlook for Windows Usage Report in the Exchange admin center will retire from early to late November 2026. Admins must use the Microsoft 365 admin center for Outlook usage insights. No impact on Outlook functionality; no admin action required, but update any related documentation.

item.title: MC1437668: Microsoft Outlook for iOS and Android: Insert signature images from OneDrive
item.description: Starting late September to late October 2026, Outlook for iOS and Android will let users insert signature images from OneDrive as well as device photo libraries. This feature is enabled by default, requires no admin setup, and respects existing organizational data-sharing policies. No action is needed.

item.title: MC1458481: Improved OneDrive experience in Apple Files app
item.description: OneDrive integration with Apple Files on iOS is improved for reliability and clearer upload status. Read-only shared and SharePoint library locations will no longer appear in Apple Files but remain accessible via the OneDrive app. Users can use "Add to OneDrive" to access and edit content in Apple Files. Rollout: mid-August to early November 2026. No admin action required.

item.title: MC1462467: Badges on profile cards in Teams
item.description: Microsoft Teams profile cards will display existing Awards and Certifications from Microsoft 365 profiles starting October 2026. This read-only feature shows titles, issuers, and details on badges if populated. No changes appear if these properties are empty. Review your organization's profile data accordingly.

item.title: MC1462923: Outlook for iOS: Minimum system requirements updated to iOS 26 and above
item.description: Outlook for iOS will require iOS 26 or later starting mid-September 2026, supporting only the two latest iOS, iPadOS, and watchOS versions. Users on older versions may lose updates and syncing. Organizations should identify affected devices, notify users, and encourage OS upgrades. No admin changes needed.

item.title: MC1462922: Admin app retiring in Teams, Outlook and Microsoft365.com
item.description: The Admin app for very small businesses in Teams, Outlook, and Microsoft365.com will retire by October 2026, with rollout starting August 2026. It will no longer be pre-installed or supported. Admins should use Microsoft Admin Center, Teams Admin Center, or Microsoft 365 Admin Agent instead.

item.title: MC1462914: Microsoft Agent 365: Active Users export for agent usage reporting
item.description: Microsoft Agent 365 will add an Active Users export in the Microsoft 365 admin center, allowing AI and Global Admins to generate a CSV report of users who used agents in the past 30 days. This read-only feature aids licensing reviews and requires no preparation.

item.title: MC1307512: Microsoft Teams: AI-powered notes for in-person meetings with Facilitator in Teams Rooms on Windows
item.description: Microsoft Teams is adding AI-powered meeting notes with the Facilitator agent to Teams Rooms on Windows for in-person meetings. Rolling out worldwide from late October to mid-November 2026, it enables real-time note-taking stored securely in tenant-owned SharePoint. Licensing and configuration prerequisites apply; no extra admin enablement needed.

item.title: MC1234571: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention – Adaptive scopes for DLP for SharePoint
item.description: Microsoft Purview introduces adaptive scopes for SharePoint DLP policies, enabling automatic targeting of sites based on attributes, reducing manual updates. Public preview runs February 2026; general availability begins January 2027. Admins must create scopes and assign them to DLP policies to improve efficiency and coverage without impacting user workflows.

item.title: MC1462472: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Draft Outlook emails directly in Copilot Chat on mobile
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat on mobile will embed an Outlook email draft experience, allowing users to draft, review, and open emails in Outlook Mobile seamlessly. This feature, enabled by default, rolls out worldwide from mid-August to mid-September 2026 with no admin action required.

item.title: MC1462470: Microsoft Teams: Clearer text highlighting in dark mode and high contrast mode
item.description: Microsoft Teams will improve highlighted text visibility in dark and high contrast modes for a more consistent, accessible editing experience. Rollout starts mid-September 2026, completing by early October 2026. This is a visual enhancement only; no user action is required.

item.title: MC1462469: Microsoft Teams and Google Calendar sync retirement
item.description: Microsoft is retiring calendar syncing between Microsoft Teams and Google Workspace in October 2026, ending support for this feature. Organizations should notify users, save account matching data, and use the Microsoft Teams Meeting add-on for Google Workspace for meeting scheduling instead.

item.title: MC1462464: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps: App Governance support for the Cloud Application Administrator role is being retired
item.description: Support for the Cloud Application Administrator role in Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps' App Governance will retire on September 26, 2026. Organizations must reassign affected administrators to supported roles like Security Administrator to maintain access when URBAC is enabled. Review role assignments by September 25, 2026.

item.title: MC1462463: Teams Admin Center - Single pane for monitoring
item.description: Microsoft Teams admin center will launch a single pane for monitoring and troubleshooting meetings and calls organization-wide, available from late September to mid-October 2026. Admins can view in-progress and completed meetings, identify issues, use detailed diagnostics, apply filters, export data, and leverage Microsoft 365 Copilot for analysis.

item.title: MC1462460: Microsoft Entra: Domain update for My Account and identity self-service experiences
item.description: Microsoft Entra is updating its self-service identity management domain from myaccount.microsoft.com to myaccount.cloud.microsoft, consolidating related sites for a unified experience. The change rolls out worldwide in late November 2026. Users need no action; administrators should ensure *.cloud.microsoft domains are allowed in network policies.

item.title: MC1454386: Simplified access to Copilot Chat on the Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app
item.description: Access to Copilot Chat on the Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app will be simplified by removing restrictions from the Intune policy and "Analyze content" privacy control. This change, rolling out August to September 2026, requires no admin action but may affect organizational controls and documentation.

item.title: MC1192260: Microsoft Purview | Compliance Manager - AI Powered Regulatory Templates
item.description: Microsoft Purview Compliance Manager will introduce AI Powered Regulatory Templates to convert regulatory PDFs into actionable controls, aiding compliance in multi-cloud environments. Public preview starts November 2025; general availability begins October 2026. The feature is additive, requires no action to enable, and supports streamlined assessments without impacting existing workflows.

item.title: MC1266912: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Intelligent Summaries in Copilot Dashboard
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot Dashboard will add AI-generated intelligent summaries by late September 2026, highlighting adoption trends and usage insights for admins. The feature is on by default, requires no configuration, and includes suggested prompts. No user impact or compliance issues are expected.

item.title: MC1388719: Microsoft Teams: Granular channel notification settings
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce granular channel notification presets—All new messages, Mentions and replies, and Mute—with customizable options for mentions and threads. Rollout begins October 2026 across platforms and environments, enabled by default with no admin changes needed. No user action required; inform helpdesk and update documentation.

item.title: MC1409304: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator proactively detects and resolves knowledge gaps in meetings
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce a Facilitator feature with Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) that detects knowledge gaps in meetings, performs web searches, and posts relevant answers in the chat to improve productivity. It requires manual enabling, supports standard meetings, and includes admin controls for configuration.

item.title: MC1319216: Microsoft Teams: In‑meeting toggle to turn Meeting AI on or off
item.description: Microsoft Teams will add a toggle for licensed organizers and presenters to turn Meeting AI (Copilot and Facilitator) on or off during meetings, starting mid-September 2026. Turning off AI disables recording and transcription. The feature respects existing policies, requires no action, and aims to enhance control over AI use in meetings.

item.title: MC1461705: Microsoft Defender XDR: Unified identity timeline on the Identity page
item.description: Microsoft Defender XDR is enhancing the Identity page's Timeline tab to provide a unified, chronological view of identity-related activities and alerts from multiple Microsoft security sources. Rolling out mid-September to mid-October 2026, it offers improved context, filtering, and automatic updates without changing existing policies. No action is required to enable it.

item.title: MC1461704: Microsoft Defender XDR: Unified response actions across identity accounts
item.description: Microsoft Defender XDR unifies identity response actions across linked accounts, enabling security teams to manage actions like disabling accounts or forcing password changes from one workflow. It supports multiple identity systems and SaaS apps, enhancing response speed and consistency. Rollout begins mid-October 2026 worldwide.

item.title: MC1441775: Microsoft Whiteboard: Retirement of legacy whiteboards and transition to OneDrive-backed whiteboards
item.description: Microsoft Whiteboard is retiring legacy whiteboards and the standalone app. Migration to OneDrive-backed whiteboards must be completed by September 25, 2026. item.title: MC1458483: OneDrive macOS Native Sync Engine

item.title: MC1258000: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Investigations – analyze files tied to endpoint DLP alerts

item.title: MC1461160: Microsoft Teams: Copilot in call recap in the Queues app
item.description: Microsoft Teams is adding Copilot in call recap within the Queues app for recorded call queue calls, enabling users with Microsoft 365 Copilot and Teams Premium licenses to get summaries and ask questions about calls. Rollout starts early September 2026 with no admin action required.

item.title: MC1461158: Prepare for upcoming changes to the Excel Exchange connector
item.description: New Exchange Mail and Calendar connectors for Excel Power Query will replace the current Microsoft Exchange connector by April 2027. Workbook owners must manually migrate connections and upgrade to Microsoft 365 Apps or Office 2024. Admins should prepare users and workbooks for this transition starting now.

item.title: MC1461154: Microsoft Purview | Information Protection – Auto-labeling scale increase for SharePoint and OneDrive
item.description: Microsoft Purview auto-labeling for SharePoint and OneDrive increases daily processing from 100,000 to 500,000 files per tenant, enabling faster labeling of large content volumes. Rollout starts September 2026 (preview) and October 2026 (general). No action needed for current users; new users are encouraged to create and validate policies.

item.title: MC1447678: Microsoft Exchange Online: Prepare for Exchange Web Services retirement with EWSAllowedAppIDs
item.description: Exchange Web Services (EWS) in Exchange Online will retire starting October 1, 2026, with full retirement by April 1, 2027. Microsoft introduced EWSAllowedAppIDs, allowing admins to create an allow list of approved apps to use EWS, helping manage access and prevent disruptions during retirement enforcement.

item.title: MC1411574: Microsoft Entra: System-preferred authentication now applies to first-factor authentication
item.description: Microsoft Entra now applies system-preferred authentication to first-factor sign-ins for tenants in the Microsoft managed state, selecting the most secure registered method. Rollout is from late June to late September 2026. Tenants can keep or change this setting and should update user guidance accordingly.

item.title: MC1459136: Microsoft 365 admin center: Usage reports migrating to new domains

item.title: MC1437679: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Capture voice notes in the Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot mobile app introduces a Record feature to capture voice notes and conversations, providing AI-generated transcripts and summaries in Copilot Chat. Available from late August 2026, recordings are stored in OneDrive with enterprise-grade security and compliance, governed by existing Microsoft 365 policies.

item.title: MC1437678: Microsoft Teams: Join by code requires owner approval for private teams
item.description: Microsoft Teams will require owner approval for users joining private teams via join codes starting late August 2026. Users can still generate and enter codes, but owners must approve requests. Public teams remain unaffected. No admin action is needed, but owners should be informed and monitor requests.

item.title: MC1287370: Auto upgrade of shared calendars from legacy MAPI model to modern REST model
item.description: Microsoft is auto-upgrading shared calendars in Outlook and Exchange Online from the legacy MAPI model to a modern REST model, improving sync reliability and performance. The seamless, server-side rollout begins August 2026 for GCC High/DoD tenants, requires no user action, preserves permissions, and excludes events older than one year.

item.title: MC1419797: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention - Extend Purview data security to the network layer via Entra GSA integration
item.description: Microsoft Purview extends data loss prevention to the network layer via integration with Entra Internet Access, enabling inspection and protection of sensitive data in AI interactions and cloud services. It supports policy enforcement, alerts, and auditing, with rollout from July to October 2026, affecting Purview, Entra, and Defender administrators.

item.title: MC1221452: (Update)Microsoft Entra ID: General Availability of passkey profiles and migration for existing Passkeys (FIDO2) tenants
item.description: Starting March 2026, Microsoft Entra ID will GA passkey profiles and synced passkeys for tenants with Passkeys (FIDO2) enabled. Existing configurations migrate to a Default passkey profile with a new passkeyType property. Automatic migration and registration campaign updates roll out regionally through October 2026.

item.title: MC1282568: General Availability: Microsoft Entra passkeys on Windows
item.description: Microsoft Entra passkeys on Windows will be generally available from late April 2026, enabling phishing-resistant, passwordless sign-in on Windows devices without explicit opt-in. This supports corporate, personal, and shared devices, with admin controls via Authentication Methods policies and Conditional Access. No action is needed unless blocking is desired.

item.description: Microsoft has released an out-of-band (OOB) update today to address an issue affecting a limited number of Dell devices with an Intel Innovation Platform Framework (Intel IPF) driver that could cause changes in performance, power consumption, or system behavior after installing recent Windows updates. This OOB update is a cumulative update, so you do not need to apply any previous updates before installing it. item.title: MC1301714: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention- DLP to restrict processing external emails in M365 Copilot and Copilot Chat
item.description: Microsoft Purview is adding a new DLP policy control to restrict Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat from processing emails from external or untrusted domains. This feature, off by default, will roll out from June 2026 (preview) to early 2027 (general availability) and requires admin configuration.

item.title: MC1430534: Microsoft Purview: Insider Risk Management - Expanding note capabilities across alerts and cases
item.description: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management is enhancing alerts and cases with note-taking capabilities for better investigator collaboration and auditability. Users can add notes, and system-generated notes will track investigation events. Expanded user details and integrated Entra ID profiles improve context. Rollout begins late June 2026.

item.title: MC1429856: 90-Day Reminder: Windows Server 2022 will reach end of mainstream support on October 13, 2026
item.description: On October 13, 2026, Windows Server 2022 will reach end of mainstream support. The October 2026 security update will be the last mainstream support update available for this version. After this date, Windows Server 2022 will transition to extended support, which includes security updates at no additional cost, and will continue to receive monthly security updates through October 14, 2031. item.title: MC1429017: Microsoft Purview: Enhanced user profile in Insider Risk Management alerts
item.description: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management alerts will display enhanced user profiles with additional Entra attributes and risk signals within the alert workflow, improving investigation efficiency while maintaining privacy protections. The update rolls out from June to October 2026, requiring no immediate action but recommended review and communication.

item.title: MC1429010: Retirement notice: Instances policy location in Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention
item.description: Microsoft is retiring the Instances policy location in Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention on January 6, 2027. Organizations must migrate existing policies to new dedicated application locations for supported non-Microsoft apps like Google Workspace, Box, and Salesforce before this date to ensure continued enforcement and support.

item.title: MC1248389: Retirement of -Credential parameter when connecting to Exchange Online PowerShell
item.description: Microsoft will retire the -Credential parameter in Exchange Online PowerShell cmdlets starting December 2026, requiring organizations to migrate scripts to modern authentication methods like MFA, app-only, or managed identity authentication to avoid disruptions. This enhances security by eliminating legacy authentication.

item.title: MC1428757: 90-Day Reminder: Windows 11, version 24H2 and Windows 10 LTSB 2016 reaching end of updates on October 13, 2026
item.description: On October 13, 2026, Windows 11, version 24H2 Home and Pro editions, and Windows 10 Enterprise LTSB 2016 will reach end of updates. After this date, devices running these editions will no longer receive monthly security and non-security preview updates containing protections from the latest security threats. item.title: MC1426709: Microsoft Teams: Custom recording and transcription notifications now available for 1:1 calls
item.description: Microsoft Teams now supports custom recording and transcription notifications for 1:1 calls, extending existing meeting capabilities. This ensures consistent consent messaging across communications without new admin setup. Rollout begins August 2026 for most environments; mobile clients are not yet supported. No policy changes are required.
